recommended_learning_path.rationale: To unlock more courses like AI101 and progress towards the career goal, the student needs to learn Data Structures and Algorithms, which are crucial for AI development.

overall_summary: Start by learning Data Structures and Algorithms in Python to build a strong foundation in programming and AI development, then progress to more specialized courses like Full-Stack Web Development and Applied Machine Learning & Computer Vision to achieve the goal of becoming a Full-Stack AI Developer.
